sources.quote: HAT-P-36, also referred to as Tuiren is a 12th magnitude G-type main-sequence star estimated to be approximately 958 light-years away from Earth in the constellation Canes Venatici.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-36"
sources.quote: HAT-P-36 is too faint to be seen with the naked eye, but it is possible to view it with binoculars or a small telescope.
